name: appimageupdate
description:
AppImageUpdate is a tool designed to update AppImages efficiently by utilizing binary delta updates. Powered by zsync, it downloads only the changed bytes between application versions rather than re-downloading entire disk images, saving significant bandwidth and time.

Features:
- Fast binary delta updates reducing download sizes by up to 90 percent
- Uses embedded update metadata from AppImage type 2 files
- Graphical and command-line interfaces for flexible system integration
- Validates cryptographic signatures to ensure update integrity and security
- Preserves existing desktop integrations and file permissions across updates
